items.title: What is a GUI? Why is it important?

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic What is a GUI? Why is it important? as printed (PDF 50, printed 46); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the topic 4.1 lesson.

blocks.text: A GUI, or Graphical User Interface, is a visual interface that allows users to interact with software using elements like buttons, menus, and forms. GUIs are important because they make programs easier to understand and operate, especially for non-technical users. They improve usability by providing visual feedback and reducing the need to remember complex commands. GUI applications are widely used in desktop software, web applications, and mobile apps.
